title: 第475章 蒸汽第474章 入侵正式开始
slug: 我的灵根等级怎么是负的
content_zh:
这些野兽全都猛地冲入水中。它们一到水里，就放弃了潜行的念头。敌人肯定会发现它们，因为它们是陆地野兽，不可能像海兽那样行动。所以，试图偷偷潜入根本行不通。
任何人类都会认为这种正面强攻鲁莽愚蠢，但这仅仅是以人类的标准来看。野兽没有阵法和城墙之类的防御手段，它们所拥有的只是有利的地形和自身的躯体。总而言之，对野兽而言，进攻还是防守其实并无太大区别。
格拉维斯位于队伍中央，而五级领主们则在最前面。他们首先要做的就是找到对手并展开战斗，格拉维斯则会逐个击破五级领主。
冲锋几分钟后，他们就发现了几个敌人。这些海兽等级各异，但大多数只是1级或2级的领主。必须记住，这片区域也栖息着一些较弱的野兽。
这些弱小的领主还没来得及做出反应，就被五级领主们彻底消灭了。五级领主们只是随意地施放了一些元素攻击，就足以将这些弱小的野兽全部消灭。他们甚至不在乎是否留下完整的尸体。毕竟，他们军队中的野兽根本不会把这些弱小的食物放在眼里。
没过多久，大军就逼近了深渊。和河族曾经拥有的深渊一样，这个深渊也是海洋中的一个深坑，既是防御屏障，也是海怪的巢穴。
格拉维斯一路上没遇到一个三级或更强的领主，但这也在意料之中。这里是争夺之地。像深渊这样的咽喉要道是海怪最好的防线。
果然，格拉维斯一看到深渊，就注意到那里聚集着数量惊人的领主。幸运的是，敌人的数量和实力与他们从猎豹那里得到的情报完全吻合。
敌人已经察觉到他们的存在，并在深渊入口后方不远处筑起了一道由野兽组成的屏障。不杀死这些野兽，他们就无法继续前进。令人惊讶的是，整道屏障竟然全部由四级领主组成。格拉维斯没有看到任何更强或更弱的领主。
格拉维斯眯起眼睛，明白了其中的原因。“只要四级领主足够多，即使是五级领主也可能阵亡。国王之间的战斗将决定哪一方获胜，而五级领主之间的战斗将决定哪支军队能够存活。”
格拉维斯环视自己的军队数秒。“我们四级和三级领主的存亡就系于五级领主和我身上了。我可不想现在处在他们的位置上，无法掌控自己的命运。”
格拉维斯叹了口气，轻轻摇了摇头。“我到底在说什么？难道我之所以会在这里，不正是因为我需要依靠上天的恩赐吗？”格拉维斯沮丧地想。
“四级领主，进攻！”猎豹向所有人发出指令。她可以派出五级领主去击杀大量的四级领主，但这可能会耗尽五级领主的体力。如果敌方五级领主出现，她们很可能会因为这样的决定而战败。
“嗷呜！”野兽们齐声咆哮，向前冲去。五级领主和三级领主则留在后方，伺机介入。根据格拉维斯的灵力感知，敌方的三级领主完全隐藏在防线之后。
“看来我们三级领主运气不错。”格拉维斯心想。如果敌方三级领主发动攻击，陆兽三级领主就必须反击。届时，他们将身处一场更强大野兽之间的混战之中，生存几率将急剧下降。
由于敌方三级领主都留在后方，己方三级领主可以等到主战结束后再出击。这样一来，他们就能不受任何外敌干扰地进行战斗。
两堵墙猛烈碰撞，格拉维斯感觉仿佛世界末日降临。每当巨兽交锋，周围的水都会瞬间蒸发。如此强大的巨兽所能释放的能量，足以在一瞬间将大量的水沸腾。
随后，各种各样的元素不断四处飞溅。空间震颤，格拉维斯的灵力感知和野兽们的感官都停止了运作。如此强大的力量碰撞在一起，几乎让人无法分辨任何事物。战斗爆发后，所有人只能依靠感觉、直觉和视觉。
格拉维斯与猎豹和五级领主们一起站在战场后方。此刻，在他们面前，所有人都能看到一股猛烈的蒸汽龙卷风，几乎遮蔽了一切。
蒸汽龙卷风的宽度超过100公里。如此巨大的规模使它看起来像一堵墙，而不是一场风暴。它实在太宽了，仅凭肉眼根本无法理解它的真实形态。

轰！
冲击波在多处撕裂了龙卷风，露出了蒸汽龙卷风中的一些缺口。水柱将龙卷风撕裂，飞向远方。冰锥从龙卷风中射出，四处乱飞。有时，甚至可以看到一团蒸汽从龙卷风中逸出。这些其实是被蒸汽遮蔽的火球，蒸汽不断地环绕着它们。
任何四级领主或更低级别的强者都会对这场狂暴的风暴感到恐惧，因为其中任何一次攻击都可能致命。这场战斗显然毫无战术可言。蒸汽龙卷风中的巨兽早已丧失理智，只会攻击任何看起来像敌人的东西。
格拉维斯挠了挠下巴，望着那场龙卷风。“如果他们是人类，如此激烈的战斗对他们的意志灵气肯定大有裨益，”格拉维斯心想。“所有参战的人显然都感到恐惧。毕竟，任何来自侧面的突袭都可能要了他们的命。”
前线激战仍在继续，格拉维斯转向猎豹，通过语音传送问道：“你如何判断五级领主何时介入？”
猎豹继续专注地观察着战况。“王者之眼远胜于领主之眼。你或许无法时刻关注战局，但我可以。一旦五级领主有所行动，我便会立即通知你。”她向他传话。
“要我参与吗？”格拉维斯问道。
“不，”猎豹立刻回答道，“你必须保持最佳状态才能与五级领主战斗。”
“只要我能杀死敌人，我的体力就无限，”格拉维斯回答道，猎豹闻言睁大了眼睛。“如果我杀死一个四级领主，就能恢复20%的力量，而我只需要10%的力量就能杀死一个四级领主。我可以不间断地杀死成千上万的敌人。”
猎豹听到这话吓了一跳，沉默了几秒钟。
“如果战局对我们不利，我会接受你的提议，”猎豹回答道，“但现在，我们略占优势。如果你插手，或许能救下许多野兽的性命，但你也会剥夺它们的自制力。就让它们暂时保持这种自制力吧。”
格拉维斯耸了耸肩。如果猎豹知道目前的战局对他们有利，那么敌方的国王大概也知道。这意味着五级领主们很快就会介入。对格拉维斯来说，这没什么大不了的，反正他迟早都能分到自己应得的食物。
格拉维斯又观察了几分钟，直到他注意到猎豹开始微笑。
“你为什么笑？”格拉维斯问道。
通常情况下，指挥官不会在战斗进行时与士兵交谈，但格拉维斯的实力赢得了猎豹的尊重。“我们的一名士兵刚刚领悟了一条法则。”
“哦？那不错，”格拉维斯说。“是哪条法律？”
猎豹轻笑一声。“恰如其分，这是一条与蒸汽相关的法则。看来她能够对周围的蒸汽进行一定程度的控制。只是现在蒸汽的力量过于强大，让她无法完全掌控。即便如此，这条法则在这场战斗中仍然非常有用。”
“你能详细说明一下吗？”格拉维斯问道。
猎豹并不介意。“她可以利用蒸汽作为感知媒介。这样一来，她基本上是战场上唯一能够监视周围环境的野兽。此外，她还可以控制蒸汽来限制敌人的行动，甚至使他们暂时失明。”
“这不是一条关于攻击的法则。这条法则完全是关于防御、实用性和规避的。我认为，与其他法则相比，这种混合法则相当薄弱，但在这种情况下，这是她能够理解的最好的法则了。”猎豹解释道。

格拉维斯点了点头。
“立刻进攻！”猎豹突然对所有野兽大喊，自己也全速冲了上去。“国王插手了。我来对付他！五级领主们，穿过蒸汽龙卷风，消灭下方敌方的五级领主！”
“啊！”五级领主们齐声怒吼，然后猛地冲进了蒸汽龙卷风中。
格拉维斯眯起了眼睛。
然后，他也冲进了蒸汽龙卷风中，紧随其他五级领主之后。
content_en:
The beasts all plunged into the water. As soon as they reached the water, they gave up the idea of ​​​​sneaking. Enemies would certainly detect them, for they were land beasts and could not possibly act like sea beasts. So, trying to sneak in just doesn't work.
Any human would consider such a frontal attack reckless and foolish, but only by human standards. Beasts have no defensive means such as formations and walls. All they have is favorable terrain and their own bodies. All in all, there is not much difference between offense and defense for the beast.
Gravis was in the center of the group, while the fifth-level lords were at the front. The first thing they have to do is find their opponents and fight, while Gravis defeats the fifth-level lords one by one.
A few minutes into the charge, they spotted several enemies. These sea beasts vary in level, but most are only level 1 or 2 lords. It must be remembered that this area is also home to some weaker beasts.
Before these weak lords had time to react, they were completely wiped out by the fifth-level lords. The fifth-level lords just cast some elemental attacks at will, which was enough to wipe out all these weak beasts. They don't even care if they leave intact bodies. After all, the beasts in their army would not take these weak foods seriously.
It didn't take long for the army to approach the abyss. Like the abyss RiverClan once owned, this abyss is a pit in the ocean that serves as both a defensive barrier and a lair for sea monsters.
Gravis did not encounter a third-level or stronger lord along the way, but this was also expected. This is a battleground. A chokepoint like the Abyss is the sea monster's best line of defense.
Sure enough, as soon as Graves saw the abyss, he noticed an astonishing number of lords gathered there. Fortunately, the enemy's numbers and strength matched perfectly with the intelligence they had received from Cheetah.
The enemy has become aware of their presence and has built a barrier of beasts not far behind the entrance to the abyss. They cannot move on without killing these beasts. Surprisingly, the entire barrier is composed entirely of fourth-level lords. Gravis didn't see any stronger or weaker lords.
Graves narrowed his eyes and understood the reason. "As long as there are enough fourth-level lords, even fifth-level lords may die. The battle between the kings will determine which side wins, and the battle between the fifth-level lords will determine which army can survive."
Gravis looked around at his army for a few seconds. "The survival of our fourth- and third-level lords depends on the fifth-level lords and me. I don't want to be in their position now, unable to control my own destiny."
Gravis sighed and shook his head slightly. "What on earth am I talking about? Isn't the reason why I'm here just because I need to rely on the gift of God?" Graves thought in frustration.
"Level 4 lord, attack!" Cheetah gave an order to everyone. She could send out fifth-level lords to kill a large number of fourth-level lords, but this might exhaust the fifth-level lords' stamina. If an enemy level five lord appears, they are likely to be defeated because of such a decision.
"Ouch!" The beasts roared in unison and rushed forward. The fifth-level lords and third-level lords stayed behind, waiting for an opportunity to intervene. According to Graves' spiritual perception, the enemy's third-level lord was completely hidden behind the defense line.
"It seems that our third-level lords are lucky." Graves thought to himself. If the enemy level three lord attacks, the land beast level three lord must fight back. By then, they will be in the middle of a melee between more powerful beasts, and their chances of survival will drop sharply.
Since the enemy's third-level lords stay in the rear, our own third-level lords can wait until the main battle is over before attacking. This way, they can fight without any interference from outside enemies.
Two walls collide violently, GraveIt feels like the end of the world is coming. Whenever the giant beasts clash, the surrounding water will instantly evaporate. The energy that such a powerful behemoth can release is enough to boil a large amount of water in an instant.
Then, various elements continued to splash around. The space trembled, and Gravis's spiritual perception and the senses of the beasts stopped functioning. Such powerful forces collided together that it was almost impossible to distinguish anything. After the battle breaks out, everyone can only rely on feeling, intuition and vision.
Graves stood at the rear of the battlefield with Cheetah and the fifth-level lords. At this moment, in front of them, everyone could see a violent steam tornado, almost covering everything.
Steam tornadoes are more than 100 kilometers wide. Its sheer size makes it look like a wall rather than a storm. It is so wide that its true form cannot be understood with the naked eye.
boom!
The shock wave ripped apart the tornado in multiple places, exposing some gaps in the steam tornado. The water column tore apart the tornado and flew into the distance. Ice picks shot out of the tornado and flew everywhere. Sometimes, a cloud of steam can even be seen escaping from the tornado. These are actually fireballs obscured by steam, which is constantly surrounding them.
Any strong man of level 4 or lower will fear this violent storm, as any one of its attacks could be fatal. There was obviously no tactics at all in this battle. The behemoths in the steam tornado have long since lost their sanity and will attack anything that looks like an enemy.
Gravis scratched his chin and looked at the tornado. "If they were humans, such a fierce battle would certainly be of great benefit to their mental aura," Graves thought to himself. "All those involved were clearly terrified. After all, any surprise attack from the flank could kill them."
As the fierce fighting on the front line continued, Gravis turned to Cheetah and asked via voice transmission: "How do you tell when the fifth-level lord intervenes?"
The cheetah continued to observe the battle intently. "The eye of the king is far better than the eye of the lord. You may not be able to keep an eye on the battle situation at all times, but I can. Once the fifth-level lord takes action, I will notify you immediately." She sent a message to him.
"Do you want me to participate?" Gravis asked.
"No," Cheetah replied immediately, "You must be in top condition to fight the fifth-level lord."
"As long as I can kill the enemy, my physical strength is unlimited," Gravis replied, and the cheetah's eyes widened upon hearing this. "If I kill a level four lord, I can recover 20% of my power, and I only need 10% of my power to kill a level four lord. I can kill thousands of enemies without stopping."
The cheetah was startled when he heard this and was silent for a few seconds.
"If the battle turned against us, I would accept your offer," replied the cheetah, "but for now, we have a slight advantage. If you intervene, you may save the lives of many beasts, but you will also take away their self-control. Let them maintain this self-control for a while."
Gravis shrugged. If the cheetahs knew the current battle was in their favour, then the enemy king probably knew it too. This means that the fifth-level lords will soon intervene. To Graves, it was no big deal; sooner or later he would get his fair share of food.
Graves watched for a few more minutes until he noticed the cheetah starting to smile.
"Why are you laughing?" Gravis asked.
Normally, commanders would not talk to their soldiers while a battle was ongoing, but Graves' prowess earned the Cheetah's respect. "One of our soldiers has just learned a law."
"Oh? That's good," Gravis said. "Which law?"
Cheetah chuckled. "Appropriately enough, this is a law related to steam. It seems that she can control the steam around her.A certain degree of control. It's just that the power of the steam is now too powerful for her to fully control. Even so, this rule is still very useful in this battle. "
“Can you elaborate? asked Graves.
The cheetah didn't mind. “She can use steam as a medium of perception. As such, she's basically the only beast on the battlefield capable of monitoring her surroundings. In addition, she can control steam to limit her enemies' movements or even temporarily blind them. "
"This is not a law about attacking. This law is all about defense, practicality, and avoidance. I think this hybrid law is pretty weak compared to the other laws, but in this case it's the best she can understand. " Cheetah explained.
Gravis nodded.
"Attack immediately! "The cheetah suddenly shouted to all the beasts, and he rushed forward at full speed. "The king intervened. I'll deal with him! Level 5 lords, go through the steam tornado and destroy the enemy level 5 lords below! "
"ah! "The fifth-level lords roared in unison, and then rushed into the steam tornado.
Gravis narrowed his eyes.
Then, he also rushed into the steam tornado, followed closely by the other fifth-level lords.
